Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Nebraska Prior Authorization List As part of Blue Cross Blue Shield of Nebraska’s (BCBSNE) prior authorization (preauthorization) and utilization management programs (also referred to as precertification), the following services and procedures require prior authorization: • All acute inpatient admissions and inpatient observation (submit through the provider portal) • Precertification for a total hip or total knee inpatient stay will be required starting March 1, 2022. Precertification is not required in the outpatient setting. EHA (ID Prefix EHN, MUD (ID Prefix MET), BCBSNE Employees (ID Prefix NEQ), and Individual ACA (ID Prefix YST, YNQ, YCV and YAW) will require preauthorization for the surgery † . • Skilled nursing facility, acute rehab, long term acute care, and hospice • Home health care services (skilled nursing visits and hospice) • Non-Emergent Air Ambulance • Please refer to MedPolicy Blue at Medical Policy to determine whether a treatment or service requires prior authorization. • The preauthorization process has been streamlined which may offer the provider automated approval at the time of the preauthorization submission. This process may be used for both medical and pharmacy preauthorization submissions. • Here are a few helpful tips to improve your experience: -Search by procedure code or keyword. Make sure you are clicking on the correct “find policies by” button before clicking “Search” -Make sure you choose the correct policy as there may be more than one policy pertaining to the code or keyword. Choosing the incorrect policy may result in unnecessary denial -Attaching medical records will help avoid additional requests for both Medical and Pharmacy policies • Medical policy and updates are also available online at: NebraskaBlue.com/Providers/Policies-and-Procedures • The following services or procedures, to determine medical necessity, using InterQual® criteria: I.198 Sleep Studies (Adult/Pediatric) I.210 Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT) III.190 Total Knee and Hip Replacement (for specific groups only) see above† III.209 Hysterectomies III.210 Sinus Surgery III.211 Prophylactic Mastectomy III.212 Bariatric Surgery III.220 Left Ventricle Assist Device (LVAD) III.221 Radiofrequency Ablation/Cryoablation for Renal III.222 Radiofrequency Ablation and Transarterial Chemoembolization for Liver (TACE) III.223 Kyphoplasty/Vertebroplasty III.274 Tissue Transfer (Flaps) (Effective 5/1/2026) *This list is current as of 8/14/2026.
